mechanism: _EM1_PASSES 3 -> 6. The exact-metric group-major activation descent runs three more passes.
why: The source note at _EM1_PASSES records that the pass count was fixed by a time argument, not by the descent stopping. A shard-0 sweep measured the panel delta AND the per-call cost of hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation at each K, giving gain per unit cost: K=4 +0.008368/+6.5%=1.29, K=5 +0.013761/+10.1%=1.36, K=6 +0.017493/+12.8%=1.37, K=8 +0.022256/+17.3%=1.29, K=12 +0.026883/+27.1%=0.99, K=16 +0.028908/+38.1%=0.76, K=24 +0.030156/+62.0%=0.49. The curve peaks at K=6 and falls away on both sides, so K=6 is the peak of gain per unit cost, not a tuned value.

timing_caveat: LOCAL cost only: +12.8% on hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation relative to K=2, measured on GPU. NO official seconds are predicted and no local-to-official factor is derived.
